title: 脚步声

series.next: The riders' group has a new pinned message: 刘奶奶's door, every evening.

setting: Two days after the typhoon. An old block with no lift, fifth floor. The order: one small bottle of soy sauce.

liu.name: 刘奶奶
liu.en: blind, fifth floor, sharp as a tack

steps.narr: Two days after the typhoon. Five flights of stairs, no lift. One small bottle of soy sauce.
Before you can knock, the door opens.

steps.en: New, are you? Your footsteps are different.

steps.zh: 收音机里说，桥下有个骑手下了水。是你吧？
steps.en: The radio said a rider went into the water under the bridge. That was you, wasn't it?

else.zh: 收音机里，有个拉绳子的说话。声音很稳。是你吧？
else.en: On the radio, one of the ones holding the rope spoke. A steady voice. That was you, wasn't it?

say.tip: 外卖 wàimài = takeaway, a delivery. 到了 = it's arrived.

steps.narr: On the table: a new box of tablets from the clinic.

steps.zh: 我看不见字。你念给我听。
steps.en: I can't see the writing. Read it to me.

say.tip: 次 cì = times: 一天两次 = twice a day. 片 piàn = a tablet.

ok.en: Twice a day, one tablet at a time.

2.gloss: Twice a day, one tablet each time.

say.en: Offer to put things away for her.
say.gloss: Let me put these away for you.
say.tip: 帮您 = for you (helping). 放好 = put away properly.

ok.narr: You put the tablets by the kettle, and the soy sauce by the stove.

ok.zh: 左边是药，右边是酱油。别弄错了。
ok.en: Medicine on the left, soy sauce on the right. Don't mix them up.

2.gloss: I'll put them away for you, on the table.

steps.en: Every day I order one small thing.
A bottle of soy sauce. A bag of salt.
That way, someone knocks every day.

say.en: Promise to come tomorrow, or get the riders to take turns.
say.tip: 还来 = come again. 明天 = tomorrow.

ok.en: ...Good. I'll listen out for your footsteps.

then.en: Then I'd better order a few more things.

2.gloss: I'll come tomorrow, and the day after.

answers: 我让大家每天轮流来看您。
alts.gloss: I'll get everyone to take turns, every day.

steps.en: Down five flights. Halfway, you notice you're stepping more loudly than usual, so she'll know it's you. 🛵

else.en: In the riders' group: thirty thumbs-up in a minute. 🛵
